title: manuscript-guard RRID record
description: What the RRID resolver (scicrunch.org/resolver), and Cellosaurus for a cell line, said of one Research Resource Identifier the manuscript types, on one day. `manuscript-guard lookup --resources` writes it to literature/rrids/<accession>.yaml with a digest of what it says; G7 reads it offline. An answer that did not come is never written: an RRID with no record was not looked up.

hit.description: One record the resolver gave for the RRID: the resource's name, its types and the citation the resolver proposes, each as the resolver wrote it.

curie.description: The RRID the record is of, `_source.rrid.curie`.

rrid.description: The RRID as the manuscript types it, its case kept.

status.description: `found` where the resolver gave at least one record; `absent` where it answered that it knows none (HTTP 404, or no record).

hits.description: The records the resolver gave, at most fifty.

cellosaurus.description: What Cellosaurus (api.cellosaurus.org) says of a cell line, CVCL_ accessions only. Its data are under CC BY 4.0.

accession.description: The primary accession of the line it gave.

name.description: The line's name, its identifier in Cellosaurus.

problems.description: Each comment of category "Problematic cell line", quoted whole: "Contaminated. Shown to be a HeLa derivative ...".
